reasoning_content:
Frontend serves. Login works with proper password. Auth-required endpoints require token auth (my cookie approach used session cookie not bearer). Let's test with the bearer token.

Also test tileserver, qgis, webdav. And DB. Let's do a more thorough check.

action.command:
cd /tmp
TOKEN=$(curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"username":"admin","password":"AdminLocalPassw0rd!"}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/ | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["access"])')
echo "token len: ${#TOKEN}"
echo "=== projects ==="; curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.localhost/api/v1/projects/ -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" | head -c 600
echo; echo "=== nodes ==="; curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -o /dev/null -w "nodes:%{http_code}\n" "https://api.localhost/api/v1/node/"
echo "=== attributes ==="; curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -o /dev/null -w "attr:%{http_code}\n" "https://api.localhost/api/v1/attributes_cable_type/"
